The pledge was made in Wukari, during the inauguration of a 1,000-member campaign council, under the Wukari One Agenda 2027 initiative, constituted to mobilise grassroots support for President Bola Tinubu, Governor Kefas and other APC candidates. The stakeholders also endorsed Senator David Jimkuta, representing Taraba South Senatorial District, Hon. Ayuba Zaku, representing Wukari/Ibi Federal Constituency and the two members representing Wukari I and II constituencies in the Taraba State House of Assembly, Hon. Jethro Yakubu Zikengyu and Hon. Josiah Yaro Angye as their sole candidates. Speaking at the inauguration in Wukari, Chairman of Wukari local Council, Hon. Bala Useni, said political unity, strategic planning and collective commitment were necessary to achieve the desired electoral victory. Hon. Useni, who was named coordinator and chairman of the Wukari Kefas/Tinubu Campaign Council, disclosed that the 1,000-member structure comprised 100 representatives from each of the 10 electoral wards in the local government area, while the Commissioner for Energy and Economic Development, Dr Naomi Agbu, was named secretary of the committee. He urged political leaders to put aside personal interests, reconcile differences and build bridges among party members, noting that decisions taken ahead of 2027 would shape the political future of the area. In his keynote address, the Special Adviser to the Governor on Political Matters, Josiah Sabo Kente, called for sustained support for Tinubu and Kefas, citing their respective development programmes. Kente commended the Tinubu administration’s economic reforms, infrastructure development and efforts to strengthen national institutions, saying the Kefas administration’s interventions in education, healthcare, security, road infrastructure and agriculture. He particularly cited the introduction of free and compulsory basic education, road construction and rehabilitation, healthcare interventions and support for farmers as reasons residents should support the governor’s second-term ambition. Earlier, Wukari APC Chairman, Hon. Musa Adda Bulus, said the initiative was organised and sponsored by stakeholders to strengthen party unity, deepen grassroots mobilisation and secure victory for APC candidates in 2027. The Taraba State APC Youth Leader, Adi Shekarau Masaibi, urged youths to participate responsibly in the political process and resist attempts by politicians to use them as political thugs. He also appealed to aggrieved party members to put aside their differences and work together for the success of the APC. Similarly, Mrs Lois Emmanuel called on women in Wukari to participate actively in the mobilisation exercise and support Kefas’ second-term bid. The Director-General of the Taraba State Campaign Council, Danladi Baido, who was represented by Aminu Jika expressed confidence that Tinubu would secure victory in Taraba. Hon. Baido described the governor as committed to the development of the state and appealed to residents to forgive his shortcomings and give him another opportunity to continue in office. Responding on behalf of APC aspirants, Hon. Ayuba Zaku Dampar, member representing Wukari/Ibi Federal Constituency, thanked the stakeholders for their support and urged them to extend the same commitment to all APC candidates in the 2027 elections.
